title: Read text from a message
summary: An output parser can turn a message into the form the next step needs. StrOutputParser extracts text; it does not verify that the text is true.
introduction: An output parser can turn a message into the form the next step needs. StrOutputParser extracts text; it does not verify that the text is true. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Explain read text from a message
Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: An output parser can turn a message into the form the next step needs. StrOutputParser extracts text; it does not verify that the text is true.

blocks.code:
from langchain_core.messages import AIMessage
from langchain_core.output_parsers import StrOutputParser
message = AIMessage(content="The club meets on Friday.")
print(StrOutputParser().invoke(message))
blocks.title: Read text from a message

blocks.text: The output is The club meets on Friday. We wrote this message ourselves to demonstrate parsing. It was not generated by a model.

blocks.text: Parsing text does not check its source, factual accuracy or suitability.
